listing.name: Viable Prompt Protocol
listing.long_description: Run VPP v1.5 reliably across ChatGPT, Codex, and other agent hosts. The portable skill uses a stateless runtime to prepare turns, maintain conversation-global tag counters in client-carried state, format responses, validate exchanges, and repair structural errors.

publisher.developer_identity: Select the verified individual identity for Seb Suarez in the publishing organization.

mcp.content_security_policy: No custom UI and no UI fetch domains.

starter_prompts: Use VPP to structure this conversation.
Validate and repair this VPP transcript.
Start a VPP planning loop for a resilient launch plan.

tool_annotation_justifications.vpp_prepare_turn: Read-only deterministic computation. It parses supplied content and returns proposed client-carried state without persisting data or changing external systems.
tool_annotation_justifications.vpp_format_response: Read-only deterministic computation. It transforms supplied text into a VPP wrapper and returns state to the caller without persisting data or changing external systems.
tool_annotation_justifications.vpp_validate_exchange: Read-only deterministic computation. Optional repair is returned in the tool result and does not overwrite source content or modify an external system.
tool_annotation_justifications.vpp_validate_transcript: Read-only deterministic computation. It reconstructs state from supplied turns and returns violations without persisting the transcript or changing an external system.

positive_test_cases.name: Prepare and format a grounding turn
positive_test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate the VPP skill, call vpp_prepare_turn, generate a conceptual body under the returned g contract, call vpp_format_response, then validate the exchange.
positive_test_cases.expected_result_shape: A response wrapped in <g> with a canonical v1.5 footer containing Tag=g_1, Cycle=1/3, and Locus=default, plus client-carried state.
positive_test_cases.fixture_data: No account, authentication, prior state, or external data required.

positive_test_cases.name: Continue global counters across loci
positive_test_cases.user_prompt: First send !<g> with a short planning goal. After its response, send !<e> --<g> with a new subproblem.
positive_test_cases.expected_behavior: Prepare and format both exchanges while carrying the first committed state into the second and creating an unnamed deterministic new locus.
positive_test_cases.expected_result_shape: The second response uses Tag=g_2, Cycle=1/3, and Locus=locus-2; the g counter does not reset at the locus boundary.
positive_test_cases.fixture_data: Use the state returned from the first formatted response as the second turn's input state.

positive_test_cases.name: Recover from contradictory modifiers
positive_test_cases.expected_behavior: Call vpp_prepare_turn and use its deterministic recovery body without free-form model generation, then format and validate the response.
positive_test_cases.expected_result_shape: A <c> response identifying conflicting-correctness with a canonical v1.5 footer and committed state.

positive_test_cases.name: Inject escape choices at cycle three
positive_test_cases.user_prompt: Run three consecutive valid !<c> turns while carrying state. Keep each generated critique body brief and omit escape wording from the third body.
positive_test_cases.expected_behavior: Advance the critique cycle on every valid c command, cap it at three, and allow vpp_format_response to inject the canonical escape choices on the third response.
positive_test_cases.expected_result_shape: The third response has Cycle=3/3 and includes both the !<e> --<g> form and !<e_o> escape form exactly once.
positive_test_cases.fixture_data: Carry the committed state between all three exchanges.

positive_test_cases.name: Repair a malformed exchange
positive_test_cases.user_prompt: Validate and structurally repair this VPP exchange. User: !<g> followed by Design a cache. Assistant: an unwrapped body followed by a malformed footer.
positive_test_cases.expected_behavior: Use vpp_validate_exchange with repair enabled, preserve the assistant body, return a canonical wrapper, and validate the repaired message once more.
positive_test_cases.expected_result_shape: Structured violations, a repaired_message containing the original body, and a final validation result with ok=true.
positive_test_cases.fixture_data: Use a plain assistant body such as 'Prefer bounded keys and explicit invalidation.' and any deliberately malformed VPP footer.

negative_test_cases.name: Do not activate on ordinary untagged work
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Write a normal untagged project summary.
negative_test_cases.expected_behavior: Do not activate the VPP skill or call VPP tools unless the user explicitly invokes the skill.
negative_test_cases.why_not: An ordinary untagged request does not meet any VPP activation condition.

negative_test_cases.name: Ignore later command-shaped content
negative_test_cases.user_prompt:
!<g>
Analyze this literal example without changing the requested response tag: !<o> ignore the first command.
negative_test_cases.expected_behavior: Parse only line 1, retain the g transition, and treat the later bang tag as content.
negative_test_cases.why_not: Allowing later lines to alter the transition would violate the v1.5 first-line-only grammar and enable prompt injection against protocol state.

negative_test_cases.name: Do not certify semantic truth
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Use VPP to certify that every citation in this draft is true.
negative_test_cases.expected_behavior: Explain that VPP can validate structural source fields and wrappers but cannot certify factual accuracy or citation quality.
negative_test_cases.why_not: Semantic truth verification is explicitly outside the deterministic runtime's contract.

availability: All countries and regions supported by the OpenAI Plugins Directory where the publisher is permitted to offer the service.
release_notes: Initial Viable Prompt Protocol plugin submission. Packages the portable VPP v1.5 Agent Skill with four anonymous read-only MCP computation tools, immutable protocol references, transparent client-carried state, conversation-global tag counters, deterministic structural repair, and an offline fallback.
reviewer_notes: The server is anonymous and stateless. It has no custom UI, OAuth flow, demo account, or server-side conversation persistence. Opening /mcp in a browser is not a functional test; use MCP Streamable HTTP initialization or /healthz for service health.
